title: Cookies and analytics
description: The website uses cookies for technical purposes only, related to user authentication. After signing in through Google OAuth 2.0 the system stores two session tokens: an authorization token and a refresh token. These tokens are kept in secure cookies and serve solely to maintain the signed-in user's session. The website does not use marketing or tracking cookies. The website uses Umami analytics, which collects anonymous statistical data about traffic (e.g. number of visits, pages viewed, device type, country of origin). Umami does not use cookies and does not collect personal data or IP addresses in a way that allows a user to be identified. Analytics data is stored on the controller's own server and is not shared with third parties.

title: Data security
description: Personal data is stored and processed in a way that ensures its security, integrity and confidentiality. Access is limited to authorized persons, and the system in which it is stored is protected against unauthorized access by appropriate technical and organizational measures, in line with GDPR requirements.
